reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

votes.bill_title: Calling on elected officials and civil society leaders to counter antisemitism and educate the public on the contributions of the Jewish-American community.
votes.plain_language: This resolution calls on elected officials, faith leaders, and civil society leaders to condemn and counter acts of anti-Semitism. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports agreeing to it; a Nay opposes it.

posts.text: Our House Democratic Majority will get right to work. https://t.co/bzrBsjjuSG

Trump’s war is reckless, costly, and disastrous. 

The only strategy should be to end it immediately. https://t.co/rDjckyRKiG

House Democrats will always stand with our veterans. 

Today, we forced a vote and passed the Major Richard Star Act — legislation that protects the retirement and disability compensation that our heroes deserve. 

The Senate must do the same. https://t.co/8W2QHPT5Mb

On Veterans Day, we honor the sacrifice of our nation’s heroes. 

They fought with valor in defense of our freedom, dignity, and security. We must fight to ensure them the same. https://t.co/jQy1JCC0pI

Republicans just blocked the House from impeaching Pete Hegseth. 

They are protecting an unqualified, incompetent man over our servicemembers. 

What a disgrace.

Cruelty is the point for Republicans.

More SNAP cuts but nothing to end a costly, reckless war.

Change is coming. https://t.co/LG4jpSQbKT
Pete Hegseth has got to go.

Three days ago, Americans overwhelmingly rejected Republicans’ cruelty, chaos and corruption. 

Trump’s response? Elevate the architect of his failed policies, Stephen Miller, to WH chief of staff. The president isn’t just ignoring people across this country, he’s giving them the middle finger.

Our House Democratic Majority will stop the terror of this administration and hold perpetrators accountable.
House Democrats are ready to make life affordable. https://t.co/w11Ui5pzRW

This election is a victory for the American people. 

Now, let’s get to work.

Happy Election Day, America. 

Let’s make history. 

Go vote!

Tomorrow is Election Day.

Vote. Make your voice heard. 

Change is coming to Washington.

Lower costs. Protect healthcare. Hold the crooks accountable. 

A House Democratic majority will fight to deliver for working families. 

4 days.

After nearly two years, prices are still soaring on Republicans’ watch.

In 5 days, they’ll face the consequences of their broken promises. https://t.co/V4i7FgYmkM

Dolores Huerta looked at a world full of injustice and saw it for what it could be.

She believed in the power of every person — from every community and background, of every age and story — to build and pass on something greater than they had inherited.

Her achievements with the United Farm Workers will be a model for generations of organizers to come.

We honor this icon of the working class by carrying on her mission and living by her wisdom:

"Every moment is an organizing opportunity, every person a potential activist, every minute a chance to change the world."

The midterms are about two very different visions for America. 

Democrats are fighting for you and to lower your costs. 

Republicans are just helping Trump and billionaires get richer. 

It’s that simple.

One week until the midterm elections.

Americans have had enough of the GOP’s billionaire-first agenda. 

Change is coming.

Republicans are raising costs while Trump pockets billions. 

They don’t care about the American people. House Democrats do. 

We’re fighting every day to make life affordable for you and your family.
Republicans’ closing message: they don’t give a damn about you. https://t.co/RSGGbG3Gge

Over 20 million Americans rely on Social Security to get by. 

Republicans chose to put it on the chopping block anyway.

They’ve turned their backs on our seniors. Meanwhile, Democrats are using every tool we have to defend the secure, dignified retirement you deserve. https://t.co/mB7wQBwt5H

Trump’s policies are hurting working people.

Congressional Republicans refuse to stop him. 

Change is coming in November. https://t.co/eMm60Jgw2j

Democrats want an affordable America.

Republicans want to continue their economic nightmare of the past two years. 

The different couldn’t be more stark.

Republicans cut Medicare and Medicaid to hand their billionaire donors massive tax breaks.
 
Families are struggling to access healthcare and drowning in medical debt because of that twisted corruption. https://t.co/lSOo2OeTRD

Raise costs on working families. 

Enrich billionaires. 

That’s the GOP agenda. https://t.co/wtWyzY3Fwp

House Democrats’ agenda is to lower costs, protect healthcare, and hold the crooks accountable.

We will win in November and fight every day to deliver.

Trump’s America: 

Billionaires pay to play. Working families suffer.

If you’re not a wealthy donor, he doesn’t give a damn about you. https://t.co/8YhoezME1g

Trump’s Iran war is reckless and expensive.

Families are paying $2,000 more on gas, groceries, and everything else. 

Enough is enough. End this war now.

https://t.co/qyhnAsuGLu

The unthinkable has happened. Again. 

My heart breaks for the innocent children who lost their lives today to this senseless gun violence. I’m praying for their families and the Silver Trail Elementary School community. 

This cycle needs to end. We need to protect our kids. https://t.co/QQkfDuS1u0

My thoughts are with @CongressmanRaja, his family, and his temple community. 

Everyone should be able to walk into their place of worship without fear. 

We must stamp out the bigoted extremism and white supremacy that have taken root in our country. https://t.co/8okJVTVVRP
Trump and the GOP have betrayed the American people. https://t.co/wWRXww0BrK

The GOP economy is a failure. 

Inflation remains too high, as families struggle to afford the basics. 

House Democrats are ready to win in November and stop this mess. https://t.co/TcVQyBIi8z

Republicans have forced the American Dream so far out of reach. 

They’re making your life more expensive, while wages aren’t keeping up. 

But billionaires are doing better than ever.

https://t.co/vvVQa9N7o1

On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor the traditions and rich cultural heritage of our native communities. 

We also recognize the painful injustices in America’s history and recommit to building a fair, equal, and prosperous future for all.

Republican priorities:

Renaming bodies of water.
Continuing Trump’s war.
Hiking your costs. 

Nothing to make your life more affordable. https://t.co/bhMLkJd4PM

224 days since Trump started his reckless war.

Republicans are making gas, diesel, and grocery prices skyrocket. 

24 days until Democrats bring change to Washington.

Trump and his orbit are corrupt to their core. 

They keep abusing their power to strike it rich, while working families struggle to afford the basics. 

In our House Democratic Majority, we will hold the crooks accountable. https://t.co/AORtdcVyon

Gas, groceries, and energy bills are soaring.

As winter approaches, heating oil costs have gone up more than 70%.

But Republicans still refuse to end Trump’s reckless war.

ICE isn’t just a threat to safety, it’s weakening our local economies. 

The GOP’s agenda has one result: making life harder for families. 

House Democrats are fighting every day to stop this chaos. https://t.co/AnPOzWzqcp

Donald Trump has lost his mind. 

He thinks the destruction of American cities is “a small price to pay” for his reckless war. 

And not a peep from GOP leadership. https://t.co/VCXv9P9Irn

Trump and Republicans keep coming after Head Start. 

So they have more money to spend on tax breaks for billionaires.

Our kids deserve a solid foundation, and House Democrats will fight to stop the GOP’s devastating cuts.

https://t.co/leObwGHv4c

House Democrats’ message to the American people: 

We see you and your family. 

And we are fighting to lower costs, protect healthcare, and hold the crooks accountable. https://t.co/DEiv3MD9hd

Costs for groceries, gas, utility bills, and housing are all skyrocketing. 

Trump’s reckless war continues with no end in sight. 

The GOP’s economy is a massive failure. https://t.co/QIRDKBI8Ht

Trump is making your life more expensive every day. 

Republicans in Congress are doing nothing about it. 

A House Democratic majority will fight to lower costs, protect healthcare, and hold the crooks accountable.

Mike Johnson laid out the GOP agenda once again.

Higher costs for you, tax cuts for billionaires.

Democrats have a different vision. https://t.co/VqriD3Ds9k

Prices are skyrocketing.
Inflation is up. 
Unemployment is high. 

Instead of working with us to lower costs, House Republicans cancelled votes and went home. https://t.co/0sm2oYZvo3

Congratulations, @RepLaMonica, on this precious new addition to your family! 

Looking forward to meeting baby girl and welcoming her to our House Democratic Caucus family. https://t.co/ezlh4rHOeS

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
